acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An elongated, dark, low-luminance feature, consistent with an attached remora, is visible on the right lateral-ventral surface near the insertion point of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct gradient in spot morphology is observed, with high-density, small-diameter pixel clusters on the cephalic region transitioning to larger, lower-density, high-intensity blobs on the ventral and thoracic regions.
